acceptanceCriteria.text: Agent-plugin version resolution never fails the marker: the scan of the plugin caches under the user profile (.codex/plugins/cache, .claude/plugins/cache, .grok/installed-plugins) skips any directory it cannot traverse (a link or other reparse point, an untrusted mount point, an inaccessible folder); a version file (.version or a plugin manifest) that exists but cannot be read (an IO or access error) yields no version, so resolution goes on to the next file and the next candidate; and resolution falls back to the synced plugin version when nothing yields one. Any other error still propagates. Unit tests resolve against a temporary profile, never the real one (operator 2026-10-20: "Fix scans in PR 87 (Recommended)" and "Fold R3-P3 in first"; IMPL-UNITGREEN-001, triage-report-b0e41c36f93c4c91b1bf2524eb579ef8).

result.title: Marker File Service
result.description:
`MarkerFileService.WriteMarkerAsync` writes `AGENTS-README-FIRST.yaml` to the workspace root. All markers point to the same shared host port. Uses Handlebars.Net templating with full workspace context. The marker template MUST be loaded from `templates/prompt-templates.yaml` via `PromptTemplateService` (id: `default-marker-prompt`). **CRITICAL**: If the template cannot be loaded (missing file, invalid YAML, or missing ID), the service must log a critical error and shut down the server immediately. Fallback to hardcoded templates is PROHIBITED. The YAML file contains port, `baseUrl`, all endpoint paths, process PID, `startedAt` timestamp, workspace name, per-workspace auth token (`apiKey`), and a machine-readable `prompt` block. Agents should send `X-Workspace-Path` header for workspace targeting.
**Covered by:** FR: FR-MCP-018
